title: Kamishiro Rui — The Fire Within〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So can you please tell us what took away that smile of yours?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And let's try to figure something out together.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Everyone, thank you...
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (A few days have passed since then, but Emu's brothers are yet to make a clear move...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Nonetheless, we must remain on guard. We'll need to keep polishing our idea as well.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wait, Tsukasa! Let's try to figure out what kind of butterfly this caterpillar will turn into!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Eeeek...! Please, don't come near me!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What the...?! No, don't come this way! I have nothing to do with this...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh! You can help too, Nene♪
What kind of butterfly will it turn into?!

rows.Speaker: Nene & Tsukasa
rows.Line: Noooo!!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: *Huff*... *Sigh*... J-Just put it back where you found it...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay! Let's play again Mr. Caterpillar!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: W-We made it...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: *Huff*... *Huff*... Rui, you could've helped us!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, my apologies. You just seemed to be having so much fun.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It looks like she's back to her usual self, but doesn't something still seem a little off...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I feel like she hasn't been adding Yahohoy! or Zoom! or any other nonsensical words to her sentences lately...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, that's what you're worried about?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, I see... Some time did pass before we heard her trademark Wonderhoy! again as well.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Exactly. The last time she said that was... When we all put our hands together and shouted that on stage, right?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, she always said stuff like that every day...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes... Well, this is just me speculating but...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: She has a tendency to emote using her unique vocabulary when she feels absolutely compelled to do so...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Wait, that means she...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hasn't been able to feel that way lately. She may be choosing her words more carefully than normal.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So she still has something bottled up inside her?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Maybe we should just let her be? I mean, we just sort of vowed to work together so...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
But...
If she really isn't able to genuinely enjoy anything, then we might need to intervene...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Then why don't we put on a special show that'll make her smile no matter what as a present!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Together.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Tsukasa! Nene! I said goodbye to Mr. Caterpillar... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wait... We just cleaned up the stage, so why's there a pop-out up there now?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The inaugural... Don't Let the Demon Lord Escape Game Tournament!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Demon lord? Game?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This is a game that we've been planning for a while, but we thought that you should be the one to test it out, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In a nutshell... You, Emu, the hero will have to keep the evil Demon Lord Tsukasa, who's been cornered, from escaping your grasp.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh! That sounds fun♪
How do I stop him?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: To do that, you'll need to use the ten Demon Lord buttons here.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Each will unleash a kind of magical trickery that will keep Tsukasa from escaping.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You win when he gives into these tricks.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But there are also buttons that can help the evil Demon Lord Tsukasa escape, so make sure not to press those.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Got it♪
Oh, but where's Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: He's standing ready by that pop-out.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay! Oh, also. Nene! Rui! Are we gonna use this in a show too?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We'll have to make a few adjustments, but that would be nice.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And this is a valuable test for making that happen, so we'll be counting on you, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: Wait, Rui! About that magical trickery you were talking about... What exactly does that involve? Just no bug toys or anything falling on me, okay?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehehe. Using the same thing over and over again makes it stale. This just involves dumping water, pepper or flour on you, so I wouldn't worry.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Geez... No thanks...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Let's begin! Now, Emu, our hero...! Please choose a button from these ten to press!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay! Here we go♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: Hm... Uhh?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: Hey, Rui...! A Styrofoam snow man just came down...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Depending on the button, many more will come crashing down, so I thought they should be nice to at least look at.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, and the water will fall during the real thing in such a way that you won't get wet.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line:
I see. In that case...
Wait... During the real thing?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hmm... Which one should I press♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
How about this, Emu?
What do you want to see the most?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Well, water would make him cold, so that might be mean. But pepper might be fun☆ Sneezing all achoo, achoo♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: If you feel so bad for me, you can press the button that lets me go...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What?! Then the evil Demon Lord will escape...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh! What's this one?!
Go♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: No, wait! I forgot that the pop-out could start moving too. Before you press anything, give me a chance to get ready!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Okay, I'll do a countdown☆
Here we go, Tsukasa...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: 3, 2... Wonderhoy!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh... She said, Wonderhoy!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehehe. I didn't expect her to say that there but...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: Huh? Wait, this is... A-Achoo! Achoo! Aaachooo!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whoa! Tsukasa can't stop sneezing!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Then it might be nice for him to rinse that off with some nice water, no?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh! You're right☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line:
Achoo...! Huh? No!
Press the escape button... Achoo!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Heehee♪ Which button makes the water go splash☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We may've gone a little overboard, but I think she's finally returning to her usual self...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Indeed. I think she'll be just fine now.
